title: 第23章 威胁朕在天庭轮不到你们教朕做事第24章 还是你离了她才真活不成
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 孙悟空话未说完，便被一名小仙厉声喝断：“大胆妖猴！
凌霄宝殿岂容你放肆！”
太白金星面露难色，赶忙上前一步，语气里带着无奈的责备：“你这猴头，也太不知轻重……”
他正欲继续呵斥，玉帝却浅笑着摆了摆手，示意他退下。
玉帝目光转向孙悟空，银色的眼眸里带着若有似无的审视：“你这从石头里蹦出来的猢狲，倒是颇有胆色。”
“却不知这份胆色，是你与生俱来的，还是……”
他语速放缓，目光似不经意地掠过太白金星。
“仗着背后有人撑腰？”
太白金星吓得浑身一颤，忙岔开话头：“陛下息怒！
这猴头确实顽劣不堪，大闹地府龙宫、强夺定海神针，罪愆深重，更不该当众藐视天威……”
【他内心又惊又懊恼：陛下莫非察觉了什么？应当不会……那位手段何等神通广大，遮掩得极好。
可既收了人家的厚礼，总得替这猴子周旋几句，不然往后没法交代。
心思电转间，太白金星又转向玉帝，躬身续道：“然则眼下修罗族余孽未平，天庭正值用人之际。”
“这猴头虽野性难驯，却亦有神通，不如陛下赏他个官职，既显天恩浩荡，亦可为天庭添一份力。”
孙悟空闻言，爽朗一笑，“你这老官儿说话，我爱听，哈哈哈，当官好啊，玉帝老儿给我封个大官当当!”
他嘴上嚷着，目光却不由自主飘向哪吒怀里的江盼，
【心道：当官正好，离这小东西近些，方便我……慢慢弄清楚她识海里那所谓“系统”
的玄机。
这小宠物，真是越来越有趣了。
玉帝眉梢微挑，转而问身旁掌册仙官：“如今天庭还有何职空缺？”
仙官忙捧册翻阅，恭敬回禀：“启禀陛下，御马监尚缺一主管。”
玉帝略一颔首，唇角轻勾：“既如此，那便封你为‘弼马温’，领六品仙禄，即日赴任。”
孙悟空眨了眨眼，凑到杨戬身边，压低嗓音问，却确保这话周遭都能听见：“哎，三只眼，这‘弼马温’是个什么官？”
“够不够大？可能管……喝酒逗鱼？”
杨戬目光却一直冰冷地锁着紧贴在哪吒怀里的江盼，心不在焉地答道：“官大得很呢，和你很配。”
孙悟空笑声更畅，带着几分挑衅：“比你的大吗?”
杨戬这才收回视线，看向孙悟空，眼底掠过一丝讥讽：“自然是大，你福气不浅。”
【心想：不知天高地厚的野猴子，待你知晓实情，看你还笑不笑得出来。
孙悟空一听，顿时爽了，得意道：“比你大就行!”
处理完孙悟空，玉帝那淡漠的银眸缓缓转向哪吒……以及他怀里那个试图把自己缩成一小团的江盼。
“哪吒，”
玉帝的声音听不出情绪，“你怀中这精怪，又是怎么回事？凌霄宝殿，何时成了抱宠嬉闹之所？”
哪吒手臂下意识收紧，将江盼护得更严实，：“回陛下，她是我宫中侍女，身涉天雷一案，杨戬司法天神不分青红皂白便要拿人，我自然要护着！”
杨戬冷声接口：“陛下，此女来历不明，出现之时恰逢异雷天降，疑点重重。
臣奉命稽查三界异动，将其带回审问，合乎天规。”
“哦？天雷？”
玉帝似乎提起了一丝兴趣，指尖轻敲御座扶手，目光紧落在江盼身上，让她忍不住微微发抖。
“小妖精，你抬起头来让朕好好看看。”
content_en:
Before Sun Wukong could finish his words, a little immortal shouted: "Bold Monkey!
How can Lingxiao Palace allow you to be so presumptuous! "
Taibai Jinxing looked embarrassed, and hurriedly stepped forward, with a helpless reproach in his tone: "You monkey head, you are too ignorant..."
He was about to continue scolding, but the Jade Emperor smiled and waved his hand, signaling for him to retreat.
The Jade Emperor turned to Sun Wukong, his silver eyes filled with a vague scrutiny: "You are quite brave for a hozen that jumped out of a stone."
"But I don't know if this courage is something you are born with, or..."
His speaking speed slowed down, and his eyes seemed to pass by the Taibai Venus inadvertently.
"Only because there is someone behind you?"
Taibai Jinxing was so frightened that he trembled and quickly changed his words: "Your Majesty, please calm down!
This monkey head is indeed extremely stubborn. He caused a disturbance in the Dragon Palace of the Underworld and forcibly seized the sea-god needle. His sins are serious, and he should not despise the power of God in public..."
[He was shocked and annoyed in his heart: Did your Majesty notice something? It shouldn't be...that person is so powerful and conceals it so well.
But since I have accepted the generous gift, I have to deal with this monkey a little bit, otherwise I won't be able to explain it later.
As his mind was spinning, Taibai Jinxing turned to the Jade Emperor again, bowed and continued: "But now that the remnants of the Shura clan have not been quelled, it is the time for heaven to employ people."
"Although this monkey head is wild and difficult to tame, it also has supernatural powers. Why don't you give him an official position? It will not only show the great grace of heaven, but also add strength to the heaven."
When Sun Wukong heard this, he smiled heartily and said, "I like to listen to what you, an old official, say. Hahaha, it's good to be an official. The Jade Emperor will grant me a high official position!"
He shouted, but his eyes involuntarily drifted to Jiang Pan in Nezha's arms.
[He thought: It’s a good time to be an official. Being closer to this little thing makes it easier for me... to slowly figure out the so-called "system" in her sea of consciousness.
The mystery.
This little pet is getting more and more interesting.
The Jade Emperor raised his eyebrows slightly and turned to ask the Immortal Official next to him: "Is there any vacancy in the court now?"
The Immortal Official hurriedly flipped through the book and respectfully replied: "Your Majesty, the Royal Horse Prison is still short of a supervisor."
The Jade Emperor nodded slightly and said with a slight curl of his lips: "In that case, I will name you 'Bima Wen', receive a sixth-grade immortal salary, and take office immediately."
Sun Wukong blinked, moved closer to Yang Jian, and asked in a low voice, making sure that everyone around him could hear the words: "Hey, Three Eyes, what kind of official is this 'Bima Wen'?"
"Is it big enough? Maybe... drinking and teasing fish?"
However, Yang Jian kept his eyes coldly locked on Jiang Pan, who was close to Nezha's arms, and replied absently: "The official is very senior, and he matches you very well."
Sun Wukong laughed even more freely, with a bit of provocation: "Is it bigger than yours?"
Yang Jian then looked away and looked at Sun Wukong, with a trace of sarcasm flashing in his eyes: "Of course you are great, you are very lucky."
[Thinking to myself: You’re a wild monkey who doesn’t know the heights of the world. Let’s see if you can still laugh when you know the truth.
When Sun Wukong heard this, he immediately felt happy and said proudly: "As long as he is older than you!"
After dealing with Sun Wukong, the Jade Emperor's indifferent silver eyes slowly turned to Nezha... and Jiang Pan in his arms who was trying to shrink himself into a small ball.
"Nezha,"
There was no emotion in the Jade Emperor's voice, "What's going on with this monster in your arms? When did the Lingxiao Palace become a place for cuddling and playing with pets?"
Nezha subconsciously tightened his arms to protect Jiang Pan more tightly, "Your Majesty, she is a maid in my palace. She is involved in the Tianlei case. Yang Jian, the god of justice, wants to take people indiscriminately, so naturally I have to protect her!"
Yang Jian responded coldly: "Your Majesty, the origin of this woman is unknown. Her appearance coincided with the thunder falling from the sky, so there are many doubts.
I was ordered to investigate the abnormal movements in the three realms and bring them back for interrogation, which is in line with heaven's rules. "
"Oh? Thunder?"
The Jade Emperor seemed to be interested. He tapped the armrest of the throne with his fingertips, and his eyes fell on Jiang Pan, making her tremble slightly.
"Little goblin, raise your head and let me take a good look."
